# aeneid-097 — run lead's corrections to the glosser's gloss.json

- `fidissima` (__broaden__): the glosser quoted *reginā* (abl.); at 659 *regina* is the nominative subject of *occidit*. Corrected the quotation to *rēgīna*.
- `praeceps` (__broaden__, added): the existing entry gave only m./f. nom. sg.; at 684 it goes with neuter *saxum*. Broadened with n. nom. sg.
